# Disposition Methods: Create Account Disposition Methods

Area overview and notes: [disposition-methods.md](../disposition-methods.md)

`POST /accounts/{id}/disposition-methods/history` · tenant-scoped token

Create Disposition Methods for a given account.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array of object | Yes | An array of the account's disposition methods. |
| `data[].disposition_method` | string | Yes | The disposition method. One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`. |
| `data[].effective_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 formatted date as the effective date of the disposition method. |

Example request body:

```json
{"data":[{"disposition_method":"HIFO","effective_datetime":"2020-12-31T23:59:59Z"}]}
```

**Response 201**: Disposition methods created successfully.

Returns the submitted body, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data[].id` | number | Yes | The ID of the disposition method history record. |

**Errors:** 400 Validation Error response that can contain either a single error message or an array of error messages.
